title: High-Stakes Diplomacy: Russian Official Visits Washington Amid Ukraine Tensions
description: A senior Russian official's visit to Washington marks the first high-level meeting since Russia's 2022 invasion of Ukraine. Kirill Dmitriev will engage in talks with U.S. envoy Steve Witkoff about strengthening bilateral relations. This effort reflects attempts to repair ties during President Trump's administration.

title: Global Flashpoints: From Gaza’s Food Crisis to Potential Sanctions Against Russia
description: Current global news highlights include a French court's decision on Marine Le Pen's appeal, the ongoing food crisis in Gaza, U.S. and North Korea tensions, and potential sanctions against Russia if peace efforts in Ukraine stall. Additional stories address humanitarian aid in Myanmar and strategic military actions globally.

title: Consequences to be ‘catastrophic’: Russia after Trump’s Iran bombing threat
description: While Moscow has largely avoided direct criticism of Donald Trump, Vladimir Putin has prioritised strengthening ties with Washington, a development that has raised concerns in Ukraine and among European allies.

description: Moscow’s refusal highlights the limited progress Donald Trump has made on his promise to end the war

title: Russia rejects Ukraine proposals from US in ‘current form’ after Trump says he is ‘angry’ with Putin
description: Donald Trump has expressed growing frustration, suggesting Moscow may be delaying a broader agreement.

title: As war draws men to fight, Ukraine's women take tough new jobs in machinery and mines
description: Ukrainian women are taking jobs once reserved for men, who are being drafted for the war with Russia. Some women are now driving tractors and working in coal mines.

title: Ukraine war latest: Putin wants to make Russian army bigger than America's with largest conscription drive in years
